articles.summary: comment » We're excited to announce the release of a new feature that makes exploring digital circuits much easier. Instead of swapping out the digital 1 and digital 0 element in your schematic, the new Quick Toggle feature allows you to switch between a 1 and a 0 digital input by simply highlighting the element and pressing spacebar . We will likely be bringing similar functionality to other elements to help you quickly explore how changing parts of your circuit affect the behavior. Circuits with the old digital elements will be automatically updated to the new elements when loaded, so you can simply open up your digital circuits and start designing!
